mapped type.description:
TS 2.1
mapped type
Builds a new object type by iterating over another type's keys (`in keyof T`) and transforming each property.

mapped type with key remapping.description:
TS 4.1
mapped type key remapping (`as` clause)
Remaps each mapped key via an `as` clause — commonly combined with template literal types to derive new key names (e.g. `get${Prop}`) from the original ones.

conditional type.description:
TS 2.8
conditional type
type Name<T> = T extends U ? X : Y
Selects between two types based on a type-level `extends` check, resolved per usage — the foundation for most advanced type utilities.

infer within a conditional type.description:
TS 2.8
infer within a conditional type
Captures a nested type into a new type variable (`infer U`) for use in the conditional's true branch — e.g. extracting an array's element type or a Promise's resolved type.

template literal type.description:
TS 4.1
template literal type
type Name = `prefix-${Suffix}`
Builds new string-literal types by interpolating other types (usually string/number/boolean literal unions) into a template — commonly combined with mapped-type key remapping.
